title: NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina Protocol
author: Juliet Bonnevie
materials: NEBNext Ultra II FS DNA Library Prep Kit
SPRIselect or NEBNext Sample Purification Beads

steps.title: Prepare DNA input
steps.instruction: Ensure genomic DNA (100 pg–500 ng) is in 1X TE (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA) or acceptable alternatives; if volume is <26 µL, add the provided TE to bring the total volume to 26 µL.

steps.title: Thaw and vortex FS reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw NEBNext Ultra II FS Reaction Buffer (Cat #E7807) completely; if precipitate appears, pipette up/down several times and vortex briefly, then keep on ice. Vortex NEBNext Ultra II FS Enzyme Mix (Cat #E7806) for 5–8 seconds and keep on ice.

steps.title: Assemble fragmentation reaction
steps.instruction: On ice, add 26 µL DNA, 7 µL FS Reaction Buffer, and 2 µL FS Enzyme Mix to a 0.2 mL thin‑wall PCR tube (total 35 µL).

steps.title: Fragment DNA (thermal cycler)
steps.instruction: Place tube in a thermal cycler with heated lid set to 75 °C. Run 37 °C for 5–30 min (choose time for desired fragment size), then 65 °C for 30 min, then hold at 4 °C. Samples may be stored at –20 °C (≈20 % yield loss) if needed.

steps.title: Mix Ligation Master Mix
steps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Ultra II Ligation Master Mix (Cat #E7648). Set a 100 µL or 200 µL pipette to 50 µL and pipette the entire volume up/down at least 10 times; perform a quick spin. (The mix is viscous; ensure thorough mixing.)

steps.title: Determine adaptor dilution
steps.instruction: If DNA input is <100 ng, dilute the red NEBNext Illumina Adaptor (provided in the oligo kit) in 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.5‑8.0 with 10 mM NaCl according to Table 1.2.1; otherwise use the adaptor undiluted.

steps.title: Add ligation components
steps.instruction: To the 35 µL fragmentation mixture add 30 µL Ligation Master Mix, 1 µL Ligation Enhancer (Cat #E7374), and 2.5 µL red or blue Illumina Adaptor (NEBNext adaptor). Total volume becomes 68.5 µL. Do NOT premix Ligation Master Mix, Enhancer, and adaptor before adding.

steps.title: Vortex and briefly spin
steps.instruction: Vortex the reaction for 5 seconds and briefly spin in a microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Incubate ligation at 20 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the ligation mixture at 20 °C for 15 minutes in a thermal cycler with the heated lid off.

steps.title: Optional USER enzyme treatment
steps.instruction: If using a non‑indexed adaptor, add 3 µL USER® Enzyme (Cat #M5505S/L) to the ligation mixture, mix well, and incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes with heated lid ≥47 °C. Samples can be stored overnight at –20 °C. Skip this step when using the indexed UMI adaptor.

steps.title: Add beads to ligation
steps.instruction: Vortex SPRIselect or NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (or AMPure XP beads, warmed to room temperature ≥30 min) to resuspend. Add 57 µL (0.8×) beads to the ligation reaction, mix by pipetting up/down at least 10 times (expel liquid on the last mix) or vortex 3–5 seconds on high. If centrifuged, stop before beads settle.

steps.title: Bind DNA to beads
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for at least 5 minutes, then place the tube on a magnetic stand for ≥5 minutes (or until the solution becomes clear).

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Ethanol washes (twice)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL freshly prepared 80 % ethanol, incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the beads. Repeat this wash once for a total of two washes; ensure all visible liquid is removed (brief spin and use a p10 tip if needed).

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the beads on the magnetic stand with the lid open for up to 5 minutes. Do NOT over‑dry; beads should remain dark brown and glossy.

steps.title: Elute ligated DNA
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic stand and add 17 µL 0.1X TE (1X TE diluted 1:10, Cat #E7808). Mix by pipetting up/down 10 times or vortex, incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes, quick‑spin, place back on the magnetic stand for ≥5 minutes, then transfer 15 µL eluate to a new PCR tube. Store at –20 °C if desired.

steps.title: Mix PCR mixture
steps.instruction: Set a 100 µL or 200 µL pipette to 40 µL and pipette the entire volume up/down at least 10 times to mix thoroughly; perform a quick spin.

steps.title: PCR amplification
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a thermal cycler with heated lid set to 105 °C. Run the following program: 98 °C 30 s (1 cycle); 98 °C 10 s (3–13 cycles); 65 °C 75 s (3–13 cycles); 65 °C 5 min (1 cycle); hold at 4 °C indefinitely. Choose the number of cycles based on input amount using Table 1 (standard library prep) or Table 2 (target enrichment).

steps.title: Add beads to PCR
steps.instruction: Vortex SPRIselect or NEBNext Sample Purification Beads (or AMPure XP beads, warmed ≥30 min) to resuspend. Add 45 µL (0.9×) beads to the PCR reaction, mix by pipetting up/down at least 10 times (expel liquid on last mix) or vortex 3–5 seconds on high; stop centrifugation before beads settle.

steps.title: Bind DNA to beads (PCR cleanup)
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for at least 5 minutes, then place on a magnetic stand for ≥5 minutes (or until the solution is clear).

steps.title: Remove supernatant (PCR cleanup)
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Ethanol washes (PCR cleanup)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 80 % ethanol, incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, then discard supernatant without disturbing beads. Repeat once for a total of two washes; ensure all liquid is removed (brief spin, p10 tip if needed).

steps.title: Air‑dry PCR beads
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the beads on the magnetic stand with the lid open for up to 5 minutes; avoid over‑drying.

steps.title: Elute PCR product
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic stand and add 33 µL 0.1X TE. Mix by pipetting up/down 10 times or vortex, incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes, quick‑spin, place on the magnetic stand for ≥5 minutes, then transfer 30 µL eluate to a new PCR tube. Store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Dilute library 5‑fold
steps.instruction: Dilute the library 5‑fold in 0.1X TE (inputs ≤1 ng may not require dilution).

steps.title: Assess library size
steps.instruction: Load 1 µL of the diluted library onto a DNA High Sensitivity Chip (Bioanalyzer). Verify a narrow distribution with the expected peak size. If a peak at ~80 bp (primers) or 128–140 bp (adaptor‑dimer) is observed, increase the sample volume to 50 µL with 0.1X TE and repeat the PCR cleanup steps (add beads, bind, wash, dry, elute).
